content.title: 2024 Peripheral Artery Disease Guideline
content.summary: The guideline discusses various studies and trials related to surgical and endovascular treatments for chronic limb-threatening ischemia and peripheral artery diseases. The effectiveness of different procedures like bypass surgery, endarterectomy, and the use of stents is evaluated. There is a focus on comparing open surgical procedures with endovascular techniques and assessing outcomes such as major adverse limb events and overall limb salvage rates.
